medium: The code’s existence stems from a design decision to isolate transaction logic within the instance and limit the transaction object’s knowledge.

card.what: This method appears to check the current transaction state of the database connection.
card.why: Aaron Patterson implemented this to centralize transaction logic within the connection instance, reducing the reliance of the Active Record transaction object on Active Record objects [1][2]. The goal was to limit the transaction object's knowledge of Active Record objects.
